in_marathi.name: Devyavesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God dwelling in the universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devyavesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devyavesh is a Sanskrit name derived from 'Deva' meaning 'God' and 'Yavesh' meaning 'dwelling'. This name signifies a divine being who resides in the universe and oversees its functioning.
